\section{Introduction}
We study Ramsey numbers in bipartite graphs.

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}
For every graph $G$ on $n$ vertices, the chromatic number satisfies
$\chi(G) \le \Delta(G) + 1$, where $\Delta(G)$ is the maximum degree.
This generalizes the bound for permutation graphs studied in \cite{Smith2019, Doe2020}.
\end{theorem}

Some prose between the theorems.

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:bound}
Any tree on $n$ vertices has exactly $n-1$ edges. See \cite{Bollobas}.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
By induction on $n$.
\end{proof}
